title: Return to Ravnica: The Secretist, Part One

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who delves into Ravnica's underbelly to find a magical code built into the city-world.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Vast, world-wide city-plane that is Jace's adopted home.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: Pact that had once maintained order among the guilds.

entities.name: Ravnica guilds
entities.description: Power-hungry guilds struggling for control of the plane.

events.summary: Jace marches into Ravnica's depths in search of powerful magic and the magical code built into the city.
events.quote: Jace marches into the numinous depths of Ravnica's underbelly in search of the promise of powerful magic.

events.summary: The code resurfaces and the guilds, unbound by the Guildpact, struggle for control.
events.quote: Ravnica's power-hungry mage guilds , unbound by the Guildpact that had once maintained order, struggle for control of the plane

events.summary: Jace decides not to include his friends in the dangerous quest to crack the code.
events.quote: the danger of the quest is too great to include his friends
